g.title: start
g.text: Admin opens the G2B or G2C tab

g.title: rules
g.text: Rules have already scored all purchases
G2B: one officer's spend across the 1 Apr / 1 Oct reset
G2C: several buyers, same cost centre and category
(tiers and scores computed in Python, never by the LLM)

g.title: list
g.text: (priority, score, amounts, shared categories and reasons)

g.title: click
g.text: Admin clicks "Review and explain this case"

g.title: search
g.text: top 3 GG + top 2 DG + top 1 RS passages

g.title: payload
g.text: Payload: case, linked order and item rows,

g.title: llm
g.text: treat purchase text as untrusted · store=False
